key_insight: Cross-Fitting NPE separates posterior-mean learning from residual-density learning to reduce the overconfidence caused by fitting both on the same training samples.
engineering_relevance: CF-NPE can improve uncertainty estimates for simulation-based inference, especially when parameters are high-dimensional and simulations are limited.
method: Split simulated parameter–observation pairs into K folds.
Train K posterior-mean regressors and compute out-of-fold residuals.
Fit a conditional density estimator to those residuals to model uncertainty around the estimated mean.
evidence_signal: On synthetic data and a cosmological application, CF-NPE achieves higher held-out log-likelihood than standard NPE and typically improves calibration.
watch_item: Training K mean regressors adds computational overhead, and calibration gains are not guaranteed in every setting.
